input: Each Q/W/E/R/T key is held at zero-based frames 20 through 39, then released; unmodified emulator stepFrame timing.
placement: Source actor X is the bitmap's left edge; actor Y is the bitmap's last/bottom row. Decode record bitmap rows in reverse order for screen-downward presentation.
comparison: For every sprite rectangle, compare the projected 1-bit mask against the source screen's rendered bright-or-normal white pixels; includes both set and unset mask pixels.
limits: The 124 white/off mismatches occur in 11 W frames (43–53): 48 also differ in the bitmap bit and 76 have the expected bitmap bit but not the expected white color. There are 16 additional bitmap-bit differences whose white/off color still agrees (64 bitmap-bit differences total). The cause is not yet isolated: overlap, redraw phase and changed screen attributes remain possibilities. This verifies orientation, bottom anchoring and white color only in matching states, not general layering or combat.
